hotspots.title: Trump administration’s ‘anti-weaponization’ fund blocked
hotspots.blurb: A federal judge temporarily blocked Trump’s $1.8 billion 'anti-weaponization fund' pending a June 12 hearing, sparking intense debate over its legality and purpose. The fund, intended to support allies, faces bipartisan criticism and legal challenges.
hotspots.affect: This story commands attention due to its high-stakes legal battle, polarized framing, and implications for political funding and judicial oversight.

hotspots.title: AfD’s controversial Russia ties and EU scrutiny
hotspots.blurb: High-ranking AfD politicians attended Putin’s economic forum in St. Petersburg, drawing sharp criticism and EU investigations into the party’s alleged anti-democratic and pro-Russia stance. The EU is also reviewing AfD’s European party for potential funding cuts over violations of EU values.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to geopolitical tensions, moral panic over foreign influence, and the EU’s unprecedented scrutiny of a far-right party.
